notes:
- New home screen: the game you're on sits at the top, with your games in a row under it. Playtime only shows for the game you're on.
- Friends, Library and Achievements cards (your level, gamerscore and platinums), plus Continue playing with your last three games.
- Bottom right says you're up to date, or "Update available!" when there's a new Hanami: select it to update (F2 still works).
- Hanami Christmas 🎄: snow, fairy lights, a winter night and a Santa hat, in the menus and the in-game overlay. Turn it off in Settings; it ends by itself after New Year. Neon Coast is over.
- Fits ultrawide and smaller windows.
